### Mastercard Incorporated Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Available on Company’s Website


July 30, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s25.q4cdn.com/479285134/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/2Q26-Mastercard-Earnings-Release.pdf)


PURCHASE, N.Y.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Mastercard Incorporated (NYSE: MA) today announced its second quarter 2026 financial results through an earnings release available on the company’s Investor Relations website at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54579805&newsitemid=20260729111768&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=1&md5=5974a0e0f7825eee7ebc9c96277fcdd3) . The earnings release will be furnished with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on a Form 8-K and available[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2Fcgi-bin%2Fbrowse-edgar%3FCIK%3DMA%26action%3Dgetcompany%26owner%3Dexclude&esheet=54579805&newsitemid=20260729111768&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=2&md5=721a59ac72532cb51c36a10fb00ab75c) .


At 9:00 a.m. ET today, the company will host a conference call to discuss these financial results.


**Conference Call Details:** Toll-free dial-in: 1-888-330-2508
Toll dial-in: 1-240-789-2735
Conference ID: 6451878


A replay of the call will be available for 30 days and can be accessed below:
Toll-free dial-in: 1-800-770-2030
Toll dial-in: 1-609-800-9909
Conference ID: 6451878


The webcast recording and all related materials can also be accessed at[investor.mastercard.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.mastercard.com%2Finvestor-relations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54579805&newsitemid=20260729111768&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.mastercard.com&index=3&md5=6a64fc7d4e703faa38daa268daf5a48e) .
